## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4004. The notification-worker email jobs were failing because the smtp-relay Service was moved from the notify namespace to shared-infra on Sunday, but the application's SMTP_HOST environment variable still referenced just `smtp-relay`. In Kubernetes, short hostnames only resolve within the local namespace. The fix is to update the SMTP_HOST to use the fully qualified domain name `smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local` so DNS resolution works across namespaces.
